description: This is a C# source file containing unit test classes for testing Orleans silo membership liveness functionality across different relational database providers (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL). It defines multiple test classes that inherit from a base class, configure the test environment for each database type, and include various test methods to verify cluster liveness behavior scenarios.
